summary: The Tenant Issues Committee on February 9, 2018 considered a presentation from Rishab Mehan, Planner, Strategic Initiatives, Policy and Analysis, City Planning on 2018 Rental Housing Market Conditions in Toronto.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the City Solicitor and the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, to report on any planning and/or legal authorities that are available which would permit the City to impose conditions for affordability for rented laneway housing as part of the report going to the Toronto and East York Community Council in the second quarter of 2018. 2. City Council direct the Deputy City Manager, Cluster A, to report to the Executive Committee in 2019 on a cross-divisional strategy to make rental housing more affordable for Torontonians as part of the Housing Opportunities Toronto Action Plan 2020-2030. 3. City Council direct the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, to report on measures to secure tenancy for renters in apartments with less than six (6) units in the second quarter.

motions.desc: Majority required - EX32.19 - Adopt the item
